name: Kyou Boku wa Jisatsu o Shimasu
original_name: 今日僕は自殺をします
source:
When I woke up this morning, instead of my usual melancholy I felt refreshed.
Even the blue sky that used to be too dazzling for me to look at gave off the scent of a warm sea breeze.
My heart feels strangely at peace.
Today, I'm going to commit suicide.
I had always thought about doing it, but I finally made up my mind last night.

[Translated from [url=https://www.freem.ne.jp/win/game/7236]Freem![/url]]
translation:
今天早上醒来时，我没有像往常那样感到忧郁，反而精神焕发。
就连过去耀眼得令我不敢直视的蓝天，似乎也散发着温暖的海风气息。
我的心情莫名平静。
今天，我要自杀。
这个念头我早已想过，但直到昨晚才终于下定决心。

[译自[url=https://www.freem.ne.jp/win/game/7236]Freem![/url]]
